properties.name: South Lhonak 10km AOI Bounding Box
properties.description: Standard processing buffer enclosing South Lhonak, North Lhonak, and moraine slopes

properties.name: South Lhonak Lake (Pre-Event Boundary)
properties.source: Static InSAR water mask boundary from HyP3 processing package (derived from ESA WorldCover 2020/21 and OpenStreetMap; reflects ~2020 lake extent of ~152 ha, prior to the additional proglacial calving expansion documented by Qu et al. (2025) reaching ~167.4 ha on 28-Sep-2023)

properties.name: South Lhonak Residual Lake (Schematic Approximation ~60.3 ha)
properties.source: Digitized schematic polygon approximating the residual western sub-basin pool for geometric visualization. Nominal 60.3 ha benchmark reported by NRSC (RISAT-1A, 04-Oct-2023 0600 IST). Not an independent satellite delineation; excluded from primary evidence claims.

properties.name: North/Left Lateral Moraine Failure Scar (Trigger Mass)
properties.description: Primary slope failure source mass on the left lateral moraine above the lake that collapsed on 3-4 Oct 2023, generating displacement waves (Mohanty et al., 2026; ISRO/NRSC)
properties.source: Mapped from Sentinel-2 post-event imagery scarp & InSAR decorrelation zone

properties.name: Frontal/Terminal Moraine Outlet Breach Channel
properties.description: Terminal moraine dam at the eastern outlet overtopped and deeply incised by the impact wave, releasing the flood volume downstream into Goma Chu
properties.source: Mapped from post-flood erosion incision in Sentinel-2 (2023-10-09) and high-res satellite surveys

properties.name: Control Region 1: Bedrock Ridge East
properties.description: Exposed crystalline bedrock ridge unaffected by permafrost or moraine creep

properties.name: North Lhonak Glacier Terminus
properties.description: Known continuous glacial motion used to confirm InSAR phase sensitivity
